Authority before effect.

Cognition proposes. Authority constrains. Execution mediates. Evidence records. The confirmation below is an interactive demonstration.

Demonstration only. Buttons change this example; they do not authorize or execute real work.

Current evidence boundary CONT-PERSIST-001 / EFFECT-BOUNDARY-001

Current documented scope: same-host process restart; persistent Continuum Computer ID and VERA ID; durable-state recovery; scoped authorization; revocation denial; mediated post-restart effect; ordered structured evidence; independent verifier. Exact public demo and P00–P01–P03 artifacts are pending.

This does not establish host migration, universal provider substitution, complete DCA conformance, production readiness, or cryptographic verification.
